title: Existence of a compatible local component leg
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, p a prime, K a field and χ:κ_R(p) → K a field map [def-weil-residue-field]. Put A=R_p [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Let q in Spec A and ψ:κ_A(q) → K have evaluation equal to a specified A-algebra map, whose restriction to R is evaluation through χ. Given a ring V and a cocone η on the ring diagram of global pointed etale triples [def-weil-pbc-etale-residue-triples], for each single local pointed etale triple t there is a ring map b:t.B → V such that β followed by b equals η_s for every global triple s and every ring map β:s.B → t.B commuting with the R-structure and the pointings to K. This statement concerns one component, not a natural transformation on the local category.

source.place: Tags 00CR, 01ZM, 07RP, 01Z6 and 04GW; localization and affine finite-presentation descent argument

proof.text: Apply primeLocalization_etale_algebra_model to t.alpha. Obtain an etale R-algebra C, a map i:C to t.B respecting the R structure, and a submonoid M such that i exhibits t.B as the M-localization of C. This uses the already proved ring-level descent theorem, not a new scheme-descent obligation.

Restrict the pointing tau:t.B to K along i. Construct its prime r and residue-field map using Mathlib SpecToEquivOfField, with the inverse-equivalence identity proving the factorization. The equations for t.compatible, hpsi and hK give compatibility on R. Applying Spec.map and evaluating at the closed point of Spec K proves r lies over p. These data define the global triple c with ring C. The kernel of its pointing is r by Spec.algebraMap_residueFieldIso_inv and Ideal.ker_algebraMap_residueField.

For every x outside r, unit refinement gives a global arrow c to d whose ring map takes x to a unit. Mapping that unit through eta_d and using cocone naturality makes eta_c(x) a unit. IsLocalization.lift therefore constructs v:C_r to V with restriction eta_c. The same lift construction extends the pointing of c to delta:C_r to K.

Every m in M maps to a unit of t.B, hence to a nonzero element of K. Thus m is outside r. IsLocalization.lift constructs j:t.B to C_r with i followed by j equal to C to C_r. Localization extensionality on t.B proves j followed by delta equals tau, because both maps restrict along i to the pointing of c. Define the desired component b to be j followed by v.

Fix any compatible beta:s.B to t.B and set f=beta followed by j. The global etale structure on s implies s.B is finitely presented over R. Write C_r as the filtered colimit of C[1/product(z)], indexed by finite subsets z of C minus r, using the proved source-library theorem CommRingCat.isColimitAwayProdCocone. Give every stage the R structure induced by c.alpha. Apply Mathlib RingHom.EssFiniteType.exists_eq_comp_ι_app_of_isColimit to factor f through a stage g:s.B to C[1/product(z)], preserving the R structure.

Point this stage in K by its map to C_r followed by delta. Principal localization is etale and composes with c.alpha, so the explicit field-point construction yields a global triple d. The canonical map c.B to d.B and the descended map g:s.B to d.B are pointed R-algebra maps, hence arrows c to d and s to d. The pointing equation for g follows from f followed by delta equals the pointing of s, itself a consequence of beta compatibility and j followed by delta equals tau.

Cocone naturality identifies the restriction of eta_d to C with eta_c. The restriction of the stage map followed by v is also eta_c. Principal-localization ringHom_ext makes these two maps d.B to V equal. Composing with g and using naturality for s to d gives f followed by v equals eta_s. Therefore beta followed by b equals eta_s for every compatible beta, proving the original existential statement.

theorem etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_component_extension_exists
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    (ψ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).residueField q ⟶
      CommRingCat.of K)
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K]
    (hψ : (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).Γevaluation q ≫ ψ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K))
    (hK : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
        (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec R).Γevaluation p ≫ χ)
    (V : CommRingCat.{u})
    (η : etaleResidueTriplesRingDiagram R p K χ ⟶ (Functor.const _).obj V)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ) :
    ∃ b : t.B ⟶ V,
      ∀ (s : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (β : s.B ⟶ t.B),
        s.α ≫ β = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
          t.α →
        β ≫ (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ =
          (ΓSpecIso s.B).inv ≫ (Spec s.B).Γevaluation s.q ≫ s.φ →
        β ≫ b = η.app s
